text_block_list.text: A few days after the Debut Race. A question lingered in my mind. Perhaps drawn by that unsettled feeling, I found myself walking along the riverbank once more.
I had seen Yaeno Muteki here before the race. But the girl on race day was――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……! You are――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……I caught sight of you in the stands during the Debut Race. A bit late, but I thank you for taking the time to watch.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yet…… after you went out of your way to come, I showed you such a shameful display…… I am deeply disgraced……
choice_data_list: ……you were completely different during the race
……you were completely different during the race

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …………You possess keen insight, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To answer your question…… the true me was likely the one you saw in that race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Unable to bridle the 『Ardent Flame』 within, running wild with fury…… that very immaturity is my true nature.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Shut up, shut up! It…… it pisses me off!! It makes me sick!! Everything just goes red……!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……In my youth, I was a violent delinquent, letting raw emotion rule me like a feral beast. I crushed anything I disliked with brute force, no better than a ruffian.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Lost, consumed by inner wrath, hurting those around me, brushing others aside……

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I don't care, I'll beat them all down!! Every last weakling, I'll smash them, and then…… I'll be alone……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
『Weaklings』, you say? Hmph. 
……If so, as long as I stand, you shall never be alone.

text_block_list.name: Young Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ah…… G-…… Grandfather……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text:
Come. It is time you set foot in the dojo, Yaeno. 
……Grandfather will train with you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The one who patiently guided such an unruly, undisciplined child was the grandmaster of the 『Kongou Yaegaki-ryuu』――my grandfather.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Grandfather told me: allow this inner wrath, this 『Ardent Flame』, to blaze unchecked, and you will only bring ruin upon yourself.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Channel it into the 『katas』 of Kongou Yaegaki-ryuu to temper that savagery. Only then may you attain the state of 『Tranquil Water』.
choice_data_list: And were you able to calm down？
And were you able to calm down？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Through rigorous training beneath Grandfather's noble discipline, I learned to rein in my temper, grasping a measure of inner peace.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yet even this 『Tranquil Water』 could not wholly extinguish the 『Ardent Flame』 burning within……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Perhaps fearing I might lose myself and harm another once more, Grandfather asked me one day――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki's Grandfather
text_block_list.text: Is there a path where you hurt none, where you clash fiercely yet honorably together? A path where this wrath transforms into a shining light? ――What path would that be?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Allow me to ask you as well. Do you know the answer to Grandfather's question?
……One answer came to mind. A battleground where no one is hurt, where rivals strive and test their spirits together. That was――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ――As expected, your vision is true.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Discovering racing brought clarity to my soul; I had found my true calling.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Temper fury through martial discipline, unleash it upon the track. The wild surge within me finally possessed a righteous purpose and path――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And so…… I resolved. If I achieve great glory on this turf, I can take pride in myself…… and truly repay my grandfather.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Though I am still unrefined…… though I brought him nothing but hardship and worry…… I wanted to stand tall and make him proud……

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And yet……――!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Even here! Even upon the racetrack, I was consumed by my own tempestuous heart……!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I must discipline myself! Such surging emotion still destabilizes the crude 『Ardent Flame』 within me!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: If I cannot master even this…… if I remain this undisciplined, no matter how much time passes…… I will never repay him……!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I must train harder…… 
My discipline was simply lacking……
Tortured by her inability to master her inner fire――yet Yaeno Muteki stood determined, striving with all her might to break through.
Standing before her, words came forth naturally――
choice_data_list: Will you let me help you？
Will you let me help you？

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Eh――

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …………For what reason? To a trainer, my current self is merely an unruly, short-tempered Umamusume. There is no merit in taking me on.
choice_data_list: Merit has nothing to do with this

text_block_list.text: To prove that was not the case――I met her gaze squarely without wavering.
choice_data_list: I want to cheer you on
I want to cheer you on

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …………You are remarkably sincere. Your words, your gaze…… so resolute, devoid of any doubt.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……Truth be told, I know full well I have hit a wall. That is why…… I humbly ask for your guidance.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: To find the way to master this 『Ardent Flame』…… will you lend me your strength?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ……You have my deepest gratitude.
A formidable wall stood before Yaeno Muteki. From this day forward, we would seek the way over it, together!
